blog_summary: Adrian Colyer discusses the migration of his blog, The Morning Paper, from WordPress to a statically rendered site using Strattic. He highlights the benefits of this transition, including significantly faster page loads, reduced attack surface for attackers (as only static pages are publicly accessible), and improved accessibility for screen-reading devices. The move also allows him to regain control over math rendering in posts. While he loses built-in analytics from WordPress.com, he prefers not to track visitors. Colyer expresses gratitude to the Strattic team for their assistance and recommends Strattic to others using WordPress for their websites or blogs.
